about: Route B's fixed size table: how high the TOP of each object is above the ground it stands on, in cm (US sizes; most videos are US). depth = top_cm - visible height (top to its own waterline, measured by MoGe-2). 'phrases' = the SAM 3 phrases whose masks can be this object; the VLM picks the entry from the phrases' candidates (it never sees these heights). 'basis': standard = set by a published standard or rule; geometry = computed from size codes (tyres); typical = spec sheets of common models; varies = no usable single size. An entry is USED only if basis != varies, on_ground is true and (max_cm - min_cm) / 2 <= max_half_range_cm. checked=false: the numbers were written from known standards / spec sheets, not re-verified against the documents yet.
